cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(xy_libass LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib")
add_compile_definitions(_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
set(HB_BUILD_SUBSET OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(HB_BUILD_UTILS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(sources/harfbuzz EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
set(FT_DISABLE_ZLIB ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FT_DISABLE_BZIP2 ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FT_DISABLE_PNG ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FT_DISABLE_BROTLI ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(FT_DISABLE_HARFBUZZ ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(sources/freetype EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

set(FRIBIDI_VERSION 1.0.16)
set(FRIBIDI_MAJOR_VERSION 1)
set(FRIBIDI_MINOR_VERSION 0)
set(FRIBIDI_MICRO_VERSION 16)
set(FRIBIDI_INTERFACE_VERSION 4)
set(PACKAGE fribidi)
set(PACKAGE_NAME "GNU FriBidi")
set(PACKAGE_BUGREPORT "https://github.com/fribidi/fribidi/issues")
set(SIZEOF_INT 4)
set(FRIBIDI_MSVC_BUILD_PLACEHOLDER "#define FRIBIDI_BUILT_WITH_MSVC")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/fribidi")
configure_file(sources/fribidi/lib/fribidi-config.h.in fribidi/fribidi-config.h @ONLY)
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/fribidi/config.h" "#define HAVE_STDLIB_H 1\n#define HAVE_STRING_H 1\n#define HAVE_STDINT_H 1\n#define HAVE_INTTYPES_H 1\n#define HAVE_MEMMOVE 1\n#define HAVE_MEMSET 1\n#define HAVE_STRINGIZE 1\n#define SIZEOF_INT 4\n#define SIZEOF_SHORT 2\n#define PACKAGE \"fribidi\"\n#define PACKAGE_VERSION \"1.0.16\"\n")
file(GLOB FRIBIDI_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS sources/fribidi/lib/*.c)
add_library(fribidi STATIC ${FRIBIDI_SOURCES})
target_compile_definitions(fribidi PUBLIC FRIBIDI_LIB_STATIC PRIVATE HAVE_CONFIG_H)
target_include_directories(fribidi PUBLIC sources/fribidi/lib "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/fribidi")

file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ass")
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ass/config.h" "#define CONFIG_DIRECTWRITE 1\n#define CONFIG_LARGE_TILES 0\n#define CONFIG_SOURCEVERSION \"xy-VSFilter static 0.17.4\"\n#define HAVE_STRDUP 1\n")
file(GLOB ASS_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS sources/libass/libass/ass*.c sources/libass/libass/c/*.c)
list(FILTER ASS_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "ass_(fontconfig|coretext)\\.c$")
add_library(ass STATIC ${ASS_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(ass PUBLIC sources/libass/libass PRIVATE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/ass")
target_link_libraries(ass PRIVATE freetype harfbuzz fribidi gdi32)
